samples.summary: Three surviving `outputError(e)` call sites were not given the acting command, so their envelopes lack the new `command` attribution every sibling command now emits
samples.evidence: The diff makes `command` part of the CLI error contract (`outputError(e, this)` applied across api-keys/cells/docs/files/notes/slides/tabs/sheets and `errorEnvelope(..., name)` in ctx switch / schema / the orchestrators). Three reachable emitters were left on the one-argument form and will print an unattributed envelope: `packages/cli/src/commands/status.ts:69` (`outputError(e)`), `packages/cli/src/commands/ctx.ts:85` (`ctx list`, which throws `NotLoggedInError` — the exact code an agent branches on), and `packages/cli/src/commands/cells.ts:139` (the malformed-`--data`/stdin JSON path in `sheets cells batch`, which the diff explicitly attributes in every other branch of the same file). An agent driving several calls cannot attribute failures from these three.

samples.summary: Comment in `ctx list` still says `ctx switch` prints prose, which this change made false
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/ctx.ts:76-79: "Unlike `status`, this command cannot answer without a session, so it reports a structured error and exits 1. The exit code matches `ctx switch`, which still prints prose." The diff replaced `ctx switch`'s prose with `errorEnvelope('NOT_LOGGED_IN'|'NOT_FOUND', …)`, so this out-of-diff comment now describes the old behaviour.

samples.summary: Backend README still documents the pre-change session cookie names and the old bare-copy `?confirm=` semantics
samples.evidence: packages/backend/README.md:452 — "Tokens are set as httpOnly cookies (`wafflebase_session`, `wafflebase_refresh`)" with no mention of the `__Host-` prefix the change now applies (contrast `docs/design/backend.md:423-424`, which was updated). packages/backend/README.md:460-462 — "only the click through it (which carries the `__Host-wafflebase_cli_confirm` cookie secret back as `?confirm=`) reaches the guard": after this change `?confirm=` is `cliConfirmToken(secret, port, nonce, challenge)`, an HMAC keyed by the cookie, not the cookie secret itself.

samples.summary: Pre-existing auth specs still assert bare cookie names but now depend on ambient `GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL`/`COOKIE_SECURE`, which the new specs in the same file explicitly pin against
samples.evidence: The change makes the session/refresh cookie *names* a function of `useSecureCookies()` (`COOKIE_SECURE`, then `GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL`'s scheme, then `NODE_ENV`). The diff adds `beforeEach(() => delete process.env.GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL)` to the new describes precisely because a stray env value would decide the assertion. The older cases in the same file were not given that pinning and now hard-code the bare names: packages/backend/src/auth/auth.controller.spec.ts:68-75 (`clearCookie('wafflebase_session'…)`), :80-84 (`req.cookies.wafflebase_refresh`, read via `refreshCookieName()`), :104-113 and :127-134. With `COOKIE_SECURE=true` or an https `GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL` in the environment (or leaked from another spec/`.env` in the same jest worker) these now fail or silently assert the wrong name.

samples.summary: Backend e2e suites authenticate with a hard-coded `wafflebase_session=` cookie, which `JwtStrategy` no longer reads on any deployment whose cookies are Secure
samples.evidence: packages/backend/test/authenticated-http.e2e-spec.ts:48 (and the identical helpers at notification.e2e-spec.ts:49, user-doc-styles.e2e-spec.ts:46, api-key-http.e2e-spec.ts:46, document-file-serving.e2e-spec.ts:50, folder.e2e-spec.ts:53) build `wafflebase_session=${token}`. `packages/backend/src/auth/jwt.strategy.ts:19` now reads only `sessionCookieName()`. These pass only because `setAuthEnvDefaults()` uses `??=` with an `http://localhost` callback (packages/backend/test/helpers/integration-helpers.ts:93); any environment that already exports `GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL` as https or `COOKIE_SECURE=true` turns every authenticated e2e request into a 401 with no indication why.
